commands.summary: Saved pinned file lists; none truncated.
Read Dockerfiles, compose files, env examples, entrypoints and manifests at the pinned commits.
Parsed YAML, expectedFactsSchema passes for 10 apps, ids/repos/commits equal the slice, every fact key has an existing-path citation.

notes: Judgment: apps whose image expects a mounted data directory or a local-disk default (Kestra, Part-DB, Lychee, Open WebUI, Cloudreve, Dex) are NOT_COMPATIBLE with local-filesystem, per the mvp-scope non-goal, even where an optional S3 or PostgreSQL setting exists.

Judgment: Dokploy is NOT_COMPATIBLE because it manages Docker Swarm and host directories; the Dockerfile also copies .env.production, which is not in the repo. The unsupported list has no Docker-daemon name, so local-filesystem is used.
Judgment: Cloudreve Dockerfile copies a prebuilt binary that is not in the repo; recorded in the compatibility citation.

Judgment: postgres is true when PostgreSQL is a supported production option, even if the default is SQLite or memory. redis is true only when the documented deployment needs it (Lago, Cloudreve, Activepieces).
Judgment: migration is false when migrations only run inside app startup with no named command (Open WebUI, Activepieces, Dex, Kestra, Cloudreve).
Judgment: Activepieces worker is false because the default container type runs app and worker together.
Judgment: Lychee compatibility could instead be NEEDS_CONFIGURATION if S3 were treated as a full upload backend; the default images disk is local, so NOT_COMPATIBLE was chosen.
labeledAt and the result timestamps are approximate.
